summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BitBot Pro V2 Phase 4 - Provider Routing & Webhook Updates. All 23 backend tests pass (100%). All 10 frontend test scenarios pass (100%). V2 API endpoints, connection activity with suggestions, connection toggle, and legacy routes all working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: webhook_router.py: Well-structured V2 route resolver with proper multi-route resolution, rate limiting via asyncio.Semaphore, and suggestion storage
connection_routes.py: Enhanced connection_activity endpoint correctly returns both activity AND suggestions with proper response structure
All 13 webhook router unit tests pass - Discord/Telegram/Zendesk route resolution, auto-reply selection, suggestion filtering, context loading
All 10 V2 API endpoint tests pass - orgs, bots, accounts, connections, activity, toggle, creation
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 V2 webhook router fully tested. All V2 endpoints working: GET /api/v2/orgs, GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots, GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/accounts, GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections, GET /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/connections/{conn_id}/activity (returns activity + suggestions), PATCH toggle, POST create. Frontend navigation, Bots page, Connected Accounts page, Integrations page with response mode badges and toggle all working. Legacy routes (/admin/settings, /admin/conversations) working correctly.
